verdict.rationale: Radar rules and value lists let a merchant apply one rule automatically across all matching transactions (e.g., 3DS for all new-customer payments, blocking all foreign-issued cards), which is a form of bulk automation, and the review queue lets you triage many flagged payments without opening each one individually. However there is no documented bulk/batch API (e.g., approving many reviews or updating many value-list entries in one call) — the API shown is single-item (POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve) — so true bulk operations for AI-native/programmatic workflows are only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: bulk/batch API endpoints, documented CLI batch commands, or SDK examples processing many items in one call.
